constraints_found.source_line: liam: "ok so someone at work ate pad see ew at her desk and the whole floor smelled like it. i need thai" / maya: "thai. yes. i would fight someone for pad thai right now"
liam: "wait. thai. cyrus. are we okay after the satay incident??" / brooke: "i'll still double check for you. no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top of the noodles. same as always"
maya: "tight. one pricey lunch and i'm eating toast until august" / liam: "cheap thai is the best thai anyway"
brooke: "count me in, just nothing greasy. i've got climbing after work and i'd like to actually make it up the wall"

elimination.downtown_monsoon_alley: Thai, $, light food, but peanut dip and crushed peanuts on noodles and salads: allergy deal-breaker.
elimination.downtown_teak_door: Thai, $, peanut-free, but almost everything is fried and greasy: misses Brooke's preference (2 stars).
elimination.downtown_river_bell: Thai, peanut-free, light, but $$ (review says the bill is a step up): one tier over Maya's budget (2 stars).
elimination.downtown_koi_counter: Peanut-free, $, light, but sushi not Thai: misses the Thai craving (2 stars).
elimination.downtown_orchid_row: Thai, $, kitchen confirmed no peanuts in any dish or sauce, fresh steamed/clear dishes, under ten dollars. Meets everything.

notes: The peanut allergy is never named outright in this chat; it is inferred from 'the satay incident' and Brooke's 'no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top of the noodles'. That works fine as a callback for returning players, and Brooke's line is concrete enough for a new player to land it.

Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, which is clean design. Every venue except Monsoon Alley has a peanut-free review, so the allergy only eliminates one option; the real work is the grease and budget checks.
River Bell's price issue is visible on the card ($$) and echoed in its review, so it is fair.
Nothing unfair or contradictory found. Slightly easy for level 9: once you note the four constraints, Orchid Row is the only venue that hits all of them.
